title: The Threat Text
intro: A message arrives from a stranger. It says private pictures of you exist. It is a text only, and nothing is shown.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

screen.context: No picture or file is attached. You have no idea what they mean.

msg: . I will send them to everyone you know.

msg.text: I will not show them to you yet.

photos.label: "I have your photos"
photos.why: Scammers send the same threat to thousands of people and hope some are frightened.

pay.label: Pay within the hour
pay.lens: A demand for money, with a short deadline.
pay.why: Paying never ends it. It usually leads to more demands.

nopic.label: Nothing shown
nopic.lens: They show no picture, not even one.
nopic.why: No proof means they probably have nothing.

secret.label: "Tell no one"
secret.lens: Secrecy keeps you alone with the fear.
secret.why: Telling someone you trust, and reporting, is the way out.

actions.label: Do not pay. Tell someone I trust
Do not pay. Block the number and report it to your local fraud-reporting service

block_report.line: You blocked the number and reported it. Nothing was sent anywhere, and the threats stopped.

verify.line: You told a friend. They said it was a mass threat message and helped you report it. Nothing followed. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The first payment brought a second demand, then a third. Paying never ended it.

what_if.go_ahead: Not paying, telling someone and reporting would have stopped it. A threat with no proof is usually empty.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Never pay a person who threatens you. Block, tell someone you trust, and report it. You are not alone.

quick_check.q: A stranger says they have private photos of you and demands money. They show nothing. What is the best move?

options.text: Do not pay. Block, tell someone you trust and report it

quick_check.explain: Paying does not end it. Telling someone and reporting does.

hints.nudge: What proof did they actually show?

rows.k: Asked you to tell no one

rows.v: The government warns about them and asks you to report
The fraud-reporting service in your country, or the police
